title: rhododendron calendulaceum var. mortieri
intro: Rhododendron calendulaceum var. mortieri, commonly known as the Scarlet Mountain Azalea, is a flowering plant species in the heath family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents in Rhododendron calendulaceum var. mortieri may exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
